# Alex Teams media operations
Instance-level, tenant-safe operational signals. No transcripts, participant names, tokens, or raw media are collected.

content.query: AppMetrics | where TimeGenerated > ago(24h) | where Name in ('teams.media_host.active_calls','teams.media_host.admissions','teams.media_host.admission_rejections','teams.call.join.requests','teams.call.failures') | summarize Value=sum(Sum) by Name, bin(TimeGenerated, 5m) | render timechart
content.title: Calls, admissions, and failures

content.query: AppMetrics | where TimeGenerated > ago(24h) | where Name in ('teams.media.setup.latency','teams.call.provider.latency','teams.media.frame.jitter','teams.media.frames.dropped') | summarize P95=percentile(Max,95), Total=sum(Sum) by Name, bin(TimeGenerated, 5m) | render timechart
content.title: Media quality and provider latency

content.query: AppTraces | where TimeGenerated > ago(24h) | where Message has_any ('Teams media host','Teams media start failed','callback authentication','throttl') | project TimeGenerated, SeverityLevel, Message | order by TimeGenerated desc
content.title: Operational events
